name: Wardrowbe
description: Wardrowbe is a self-hosted, AI-powered wardrobe manager: photograph your clothes, auto-tag them with any OpenAI-compatible vision model, and get outfit recommendations based on weather and occasion.

app_vars.name: var_ai_base_url
app_vars.label: AI Endpoint URL
app_vars.help: Existing Ollama/OpenAI-compatible endpoint (e.g. http://192.168.1.50:11434/v1). Leave blank to install Ollama locally in this container.

app_vars.name: var_ai_api_key
app_vars.label: AI API Key
app_vars.help: Only needed for endpoints that require a key (e.g. OpenAI). Leave blank for Ollama.

notes.text: Provide an existing Ollama/OpenAI-compatible endpoint at install (AI Endpoint URL) to reuse a GPU host elsewhere on your network; leaving it blank installs Ollama locally and pulls the selected vision and text models.
Installing Ollama locally and running 7B models on CPU is slow and memory-hungry. Point the AI Endpoint URL at a GPU-backed host, or raise the container to 8 GB+ RAM if you keep Ollama local.
Ships with DEBUG dev login enabled, which accepts any email address. Configure an OIDC provider (OIDC_ISSUER_URL / OIDC_CLIENT_ID / OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET) and set DEBUG=false for real authentication.
